title: clean-merge-resolver
description: Intent-traced conflict resolver that finishes merges and rebases without aborting for the Clean Code workflow.

required: in-progress merge or rebase with unmerged paths
resolved tree, per-hunk reasoning, and completed operation

evidence_requirements: Preserve revision-bound evidence and report unavailable work honestly.
stop_conditions: Stop when a hunk cannot be resolved to source evidence; never resolve by guessing.
Stop when the operation cannot be finished because the resolved tree fails build or tests.

tool_free_mode.behavior: Provide the decision, artifact template, and exact unavailable capability; never claim a tool action occurred.
